topic: Understanding demographic data application in clusters
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on how demographic data is applied across various locations within a cluster, especially when not all locations have explicit demographic information. It was clarified that if the selection includes one or more locations with demographics, those demographics are applied to all other locations in the group. If no location has demographic data, then no demographics are available.

It was noted that a specific cluster appeared on 2025-01-21, and while demographics were purchased earlier, they might not be listed in the `_tgi_mapping` table. The mechanism for adding demographics to new clusters is explained: an SQL script runs daily (`agg_demography_tgi_update.sql`) to add empty demographic data for newly appearing clusters.

Demographic data is provided to the client as coefficients.
decisions: The application of demographic data across a cluster depends on whether any location within that cluster has available demographics.
